**Question:** What is the magnitude of the electric field at a distance of $10\text{ m}$ for $5\text{ C}$ charge?

**Answer:** We know,

$$E = k \frac{q}{r^2}$$

Here,

$$q = 5\text{ C}$$
$$q_2 = -1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}$$
$$r = 10\text{ m}$$
$$k = 9 \times 10^9\text{ Nm}^2/\text{C}^2$$

So,

$$E = \frac{9 \times 10^9 \times 5}{10^2}\text{ N/C} = 4.5 \times 10^8\text{ N/C}$$
